annotations.description: Using Voyage's End proactively on a 1/1 Archfiend's Vessel is a poor exchange. The bounce spell is worth much more targeting a larger threat later in the game. The Vessel is only 1 power and the opponent will likely just replay it next turn, meaning this trade of a card for minimal tempo is inefficient.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Voyage's End targeting Archfiend's Vessel (a 1/1) during precombat main phase
annotations.betterLine: Hold Voyage's End and pass the turn. Use it reactively later on a higher-value target, or to save your own creature from removal. A 1/1 lifelink doesn't warrant spending a card to bounce.

annotations.description: Discarded Thriving Heath instead of Island when the hand contains multiple WW spells (Basri Ket, Basri's Acolyte, Knight of the Tusk) but the board only has one white source (Plains). Thriving Heath would provide a second white source enabling these key cards, while the Island offers redundant blue mana (already have Island + Thriving Isle).
annotations.betterLine: Discard Island instead, keeping Thriving Heath to ensure access to WW for Basri Ket on turn 6 and Basri's Acolyte afterward.

annotations.description: Used Eliminate to destroy Basri's Acolyte during combat, but Basri's Acolyte was already going to die in the trade with Ashmouth Hound (2 power + 1 trigger damage = 3 total vs 3 toughness). Eliminate was wasted to save a 2/1 Ashmouth Hound, spending premium removal for minimal gain.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Eliminate on Basri's Acolyte during combat to prevent the trade and save Ashmouth Hound.
annotations.betterLine: Hold Eliminate for a more impactful target. Basri's Acolyte was already dying to the Ashmouth Hound trade. Saving a 2/1 is not worth a premium removal spell that could answer a future threat that wouldn't die in combat.

annotations.description: Used Eliminate (premium removal) during combat to save Ashmouth Hound from a trade with Basri's Acolyte, but Basri's Acolyte was going to die in combat anyway from Ashmouth Hound's 2 combat damage + 1 ability damage = 3 vs 3 toughness. Eliminate was spent solely to preserve a 2/1 creature, wasting a card that could answer future high-value targets like planeswalkers.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Eliminate on Basri's Acolyte during combat to prevent it from killing Ashmouth Hound in the trade
annotations.betterLine: Let combat resolve naturally - Basri's Acolyte dies to Ashmouth Hound's damage anyway (trades), and save Eliminate for a more impactful target like a planeswalker or key creature later

annotations.description: Used Reanimate to get back a 2/1 Ashmouth Hound (losing 2 life) when a devastating combo line was available. By playing Mountain first (5 mana total), casting Crypt Lurker and sacrificing Archfiend's Vessel to its ETB (drawing a card), then casting Reanimate on Archfiend's Vessel, it would return from the graveyard triggering its ability to exile itself and create a 5/5 flying Demon token. This line produces a 3/4 + 5/5 flyer + draws a card for 5 mana and 1 life, versus getting a 2/1 for 1 mana and 2 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Reanimate targeting Ashmouth Hound from graveyard, getting a 2/1 for 2 life.
annotations.betterLine: Play Mountain (land drop), cast Crypt Lurker (sacrifice Archfiend's Vessel to draw a card), then cast Reanimate targeting Archfiend's Vessel — it enters from the graveyard, exiles itself, and creates a 5/5 flying Demon token. Net result: 3/4 body + 5/5 flyer + card drawn.

annotations.description: Passed the postcombat main phase with 4 untapped lands and three castable spells in hand, deploying nothing while the opponent just landed Basri Ket (a must-answer planeswalker) and Basri's Acolyte. The player wasted an entire turn's worth of mana development against a growing board threat.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority with no spells cast, ending the turn with 4 mana unused.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Crypt Lurker (3/4 for {3}{B}) and potentially sacrifice the 1/1 Archfiend's Vessel to draw a card, developing a meaningful blocker/attacker to pressure Basri Ket. Alternatively, cast Bloodrock Cyclops (3/3) to add pressure, or Funeral Rites to dig for answers to the planeswalker.

annotations.description: Blocked Basri's Acolyte (3/4 with lifelink) with Ashmouth Hound (2/1). The Hound deals 3 total damage (2 combat + 1 trigger) but doesn't kill the Acolyte - it survives at 1 toughness. The opponent gains 3 life from lifelink regardless of blocking. MiniMx loses their Ashmouth Hound for nothing more than reducing the Acolyte to 1 toughness, which can be undone by Basri Ket's +1 ability next turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Blocked Basri's Acolyte with Ashmouth Hound, trading the Hound for partial damage on the Acolyte
annotations.betterLine: Don't block. Take 3 damage (19→16 life is comfortable) and keep Ashmouth Hound for future use - either as an attacker, future favorable blocks, or as sacrifice fodder for Crypt Lurker to draw a card.

annotations.description: Cast Crypt Lurker before playing Mountain from hand. Should always play the land first to maximize available mana. With 6 lands untapped after playing Mountain, they'd have 2 mana remaining after casting Crypt Lurker (instead of 1), which is better for flexibility even if there's nothing immediate to do with it.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Crypt Lurker without first playing Mountain from hand
annotations.betterLine: Play Mountain first, then cast Crypt Lurker. The land play is free and should always come before spending mana when there's no reason to delay it.

annotations.description: Crypt Lurker's ETB trigger offers a free card draw by sacrificing a creature or discarding a creature card. The player timed out and declined, missing a free draw. They had Archfiend's Vessel (1/1) on the battlefield to sacrifice, or Bloodrock Cyclops in hand to discard. Either option would have netted a card for minimal cost.
annotations.actionTaken: Timed out and declined Crypt Lurker's ETB ability, getting no card draw.
annotations.betterLine: Discard Bloodrock Cyclops (a mediocre forced-attacker facing an opponent with a 3/4 blocker and Basri Ket) to draw a card, or sacrifice Archfiend's Vessel to draw a card and potentially set up future reanimation synergy.

annotations.description: MiniMx Proud timed out on Crypt Lurker's ETB trigger, missing the opportunity to sacrifice Archfiend's Vessel (a 1/1) or discard Bloodrock Cyclops (a forced attacker that's a liability against the opponent's board) to draw a card. Either option would have been a favorable trade for card advantage in a position where the opponent has Basri Ket building loyalty and Coastal Piracy threatening card advantage.
annotations.actionTaken: Timed out (no response), declining Crypt Lurker's ETB ability and drawing no card.
annotations.betterLine: Discard Bloodrock Cyclops (a liability as a forced attacker into Basri Ket and a 3/4 blocker) to draw a card, or sacrifice Archfiend's Vessel (low-impact 1/1) to draw a card.

annotations.description: Magma Jet was aimed at the opponent's face (27→25 life) instead of Basri Ket (loyalty 5→3). Basri Ket is the opponent's primary value engine, has been pumping creatures with +1/+1 counters every turn, and is approaching ultimate at loyalty 6. Reducing it to 3 loyalty would make it vulnerable to being killed by attackers or another burn spell, while 2 damage to a 27-life opponent is nearly irrelevant when MiniMx Proud is at 13 life and losing the board.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Magma Jet targeting opponent's face for 2 damage
annotations.betterLine: Cast Magma Jet targeting Basri Ket to reduce its loyalty from 5 to 3, making it much easier to remove and preventing it from ultimating or continuing to generate value

annotations.description: Activated Spectral Sailor's draw ability precombat, tapping it and spending 4 of 6 mana. With Coastal Piracy on the battlefield and opponent's creatures mostly tapped, Spectral Sailor (flying) would very likely connect in combat and draw a card from Coastal Piracy anyway, plus deal 1 damage. Using the ability precombat wastes the attack, the Piracy trigger, and leaves very little mana for deploying creatures.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Spectral Sailor's {3}{U} draw ability precombat main phase.
annotations.betterLine: Use Basri Ket's ability first (e.g. +1 on Basri's Acolyte or -2 for token generation), then attack with Spectral Sailor and Basri's Acolyte to draw cards via Coastal Piracy and deal damage. Save Spectral Sailor's activated ability for opponent's end step when mana would otherwise go unused.
